page.layout: One page of text, with running head at top and page number at top left; left margin notes (CIↄ. Io. / LXXVI. style marks) beside the first lines; below the text a centred heading and a large engraving of a monument with inscription; no notes below.

main_text.l: {CIↄ. Io.} suæ famæ consultum, quâ Caroli Philippique Præfectorum gloriam veris
& sempiternis laudibus superasset. Victurâ haud dubiè, quamdiu
natura rerum aut mari limes sit. Quamobrem aggere marino ad finem
perducto, è Senatu regio Adrianus Vastartius & Ioannes Carolus Harli-
ngam profecti, monumentum in ipso littore erexere, quod effigie TER-
MINI maritimis mediterraneisque Westergois limitem daret, omnemque
in posterum reficiendi curandique aggeris litem amoveret.
Scribit M. Heymannus duodena ex coctili latere millia fundamento
substrata columnamque supra aggeris marini superficiem in viginti

page.notes: Engraving of a column monument with a double-headed herm bust at top, the inscription "TERMINVS" on the die, a shield, and the base inscription "CASPARI A ROBLES EQVITI DOMINO DE BILLI &c" with a signature line "Ponti... fecit" at the foot; the lines of the base inscription are partly illegible in the scan. Left-margin marks are the signature-style marks "CIↄ. Io." and "LXXVI." (partly illegible).
